note: The SPY/USDG pool drifted above fair value over the weekend. WRAPPER-PREMIUM is a stub in M2 (not armed).

assumptions: chain reads always succeed (FRESH); pool mid/tick/liquidity are the latest swap's
HL: latest closed candle, FRESH while the candle covers the tick (the live websocket would be ticking)
k: the engine's last completed regular session (no look-ahead); RH fresh with no halt (RH halts were not recorded for these windows); no corporate action pending
lane riskAddingOpen: ChainlinkFence rules on the recorded Chainlink rounds (FEED_DEAD > 26 h, MARKET_CLOSED UTC Sat 00:00 → Mon 01:00); USDG feed assumed sound
stock token effectiveAt = 0 (SPY's current effectiveAt (Thu Sep 17) postdates the window; no step is known inside it)
planned reranges / exits land instantly; approvals, the guard and gas are not replayed
cost hurdle gas: base fee 0.061824 gwei, ETH/USD 2639.89 (agent/README.md "Economics at M2 size")
headline: Market closed Fri 08-28 20:00 ET → Sun 08-30 20:00 ET (48 h; the window opens inside it at Sat 08-29 00:00 ET, so 44 h of it are replayed): risk-adding blocked on every tick; first allowed again Sun 08-30 21:00 ET.
Risk-adding blocked 45.42 h of 64 h; largest pool-vs-fair gap 128.7 bp, pool above fair (Sun 08-30 18:45 ET); median |gap| 33.5 bp closed vs 10 bp open.
Pool premium over fair peaked at 128.7 bp (Sun 08-30 18:45 ET); above 25 bp for 37.03 h. WRAPPER-PREMIUM is a stub in M2: not armed.

A control lane in range all through the 44 h of the closed window replayed ($1k, ±100 ticks) paid $9.54 to informed flow and earned $11.19 in fees (net $1.65). DeltaDesk's gates blocked risk-adding on every closed tick (M2 runs no lane on this pool).

controlLane.definition: $1,000 in a ±100-tick straddle kept centred on the pool price (always in range), sharing each swap pro rata to its share of the active liquidity at tick_before (M1 attribution rule); picked-off = HL-referenced 1 h markout (picked_hl_1h), valid markouts only
